audience: developers and on-call engineers who track application errors and deploys in Airbrake

useCases.title: Find the most frequent errors in a project
useCases.text: The AI lists a project's error groups, ordered by notice count or last notice, with error type, message, environment and counts, so you see what hurts most.

useCases.title: Inspect one error and its latest occurrences
useCases.text: The AI opens an error group with its full backtrace, then lists its notices with app version, user, URL and request params to show how it happens.

useCases.title: Check if an error is spiking or fading
useCases.text: The AI reads the occurrence counts over time of one error group, or of a whole project, including notices dropped by rate limits or quota.

useCases.title: Match new errors to a recent deploy
useCases.text: The AI lists tracked deploys with environment, deployer, revision and version, and error groups filtered by deploy, so you can link errors to a release.

useCases.title: Mute a noisy error or unmute it again
useCases.text: The AI mutes an error group, which stops its notifications while notices are still recorded, or unmutes it so notifications resume.
